sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MB UPR LOW WILL ELONGATE SW-NE AS THE SYSTEM CONTINUES SLOWLY ESE TOWARD LK SUPERIOR THIS PERIOD. ELSEWHERE...GRT BASIN TROUGH/VORT COMPLEX EXPECTED TO BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED...EVOLVING INTO A CLOSED LOW OVER CNTRL AZ BY 12Z TUE AS DOWNSTREAM DISTURBANCE NOW OVER MO CONTINUES ENE ACROSS THE OH VLY TO THE NRN APPALACHIANS/LWR GRT LKS. AT THE SFC...COLD FRONT ATTM EXTENDING FROM CNTRL IL TO N TX AND CNTRL NM SHOULD ADVANCE STEADILY S TO SE THROUGH THE PERIOD...REACHING THE UPR OH VLY...WRN TN...AND SE TX BY 12Z TUE. MEANWHILE...EXPECT W-E WARM/STNRY FRONT IN IL/IND/OH TO EDGE SLIGHTLY NWD TODAY AS SHALLOW BACK-DOOR BOUNDARY CONTINUES W/SW ACROSS GA. SEASONABLY WARM AND HUMID AIR WILL REMAIN IN PLACE OVER PARTS OF THE S CNTRL AND E CNTRL U.S. AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT AND S OF THE WARM FRONT...BENEATH A LINGERING EML. WHILE THIS WILL FOSTER AMPLE DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION FOR SVR TSTMS...RELATIVELY WEAK LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND MID/UPR LVL FLOW WILL TEND TO MITIGATE OVERALL SVR THREAT.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN TX THIS AFTN THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: SWD-MOVING COLD FRONT WILL SERVE AS A FOCUS FOR AFTN STORMS OVER THE TX HILL COUNTRY AND ADJACENT REGION LATER TODAY...WHERE VERY MOIST AIR /PW AOA 1.50 INCHES/ WILL RESIDE BENEATH A DEEP/BROAD EML. DEVELOPMENT MAY BE ASSISTED BY DISTURBANCES EJECTED ENEWD FROM AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH OVER THE SOUTHWEST. WIND PROFILES WILL REMAIN COMPARATIVELY WEAK. BUT MODERATE...WLY HIGH LVL FLOW ATOP ESELY LOW LVL WINDS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO 30-40 KT DEEP WNWLY SHEAR...FOSTERING SOME DEGREE OF STORM ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE. OVERALL SETUP APPEARS FAVORABLE FOR THE EVENTUAL DEVELOPMENT OF ONE OR MORE LARGE STORM CLUSTERS. THESE COULD YIELD VERY LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND AS THEY MOVE/DEVELOP GENERALLY E TO SE INTO THE EVE. SOME OF THE CLUSTERS COULD PERSIST/REDEVELOP OVER SRN PARTS OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA THROUGH EARLY TUE...WITH A LIMITED THREAT FOR SVR WIND/HAIL.

sections.title: ARKLATEX TO THE UPR OH VLY TODAY
sections.text: POCKETS OF STRONG SFC HEATING WILL OCCUR TODAY FROM THE ARKLATEX NE INTO THE OH VLY...OUTSIDE OF ON-GOING WARM SECTOR CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS S AND E OF THE AFOREMENTIONED COLD AND WARM FRONTS. WIND FIELDS/SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK THROUGHOUT THE REGION. BUT STRONG BUOYANCY...ESPECIALLY IN THE ARKLATEX WHERE RESIDUAL EML WILL BOOST SBCAPE TO AOA 2500 J/KG...MAY SUPPORT A RISK FOR PULSE STORMS/MULTICELLS WITH SVR HAIL AND WIND. FARTHER NE... ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH MO UPR DISTURBANCE MAY OFFSET SOMEWHAT WEAKER BUOYANCY AND ELEVATE THE RISK FOR SVR WIND/HAIL IN THE OH VLY. A FEW LONGER-LIVED STORMS ALSO MAY FORM ALONG WARM FRONT IN OH/WRN PA. WHATEVER SVR RISK DOES EMERGE IN THESE REGIONS SHOULD...HOWEVER...BE MAINLY DIURNAL.

sections.title: ERN GULF CST/GA THIS AFTN
sections.text: SCTD MULTICELLS/MULTICELL CLUSTERS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTN FROM SRN AL INTO PARTS OF GA AND N FL...WITH DEVELOPMENT FOCUSED ON OUTFLOW/SEA BREEZE BOUNDARIES AND BACK-DOOR FRONT. INSTABILITY SHOULD BE SOMEWHAT REDUCED RELATIVE TO YESTERDAY /AROUND 1500 J PER KG/...AND WIND FIELD WILL BE WEAKER. WHILE HIGH PW VALUES MAY CONTRIBUTE TO A FEW STORMS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WIND...THREAT FOR MORE THAN ISOLD/BRIEFLY SVR WEATHER APPEARS LOW. ..CORFIDI/GARNER.. 05/07/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER LOW OVER SRN MANITOBA WILL EVOLVE INTO AN OPEN WAVE AND ELONGATE IN SW-NE FASHION FROM THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS INTO UPPER GREAT LAKES WHILE SWRN U.S. TROUGH FORMS A CLOSED CIRCULATION OVER THE LOWER CO VALLEY. ELSEWHERE...A VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER THE MID MS VALLEY WILL PROGRESS ACROSS THE OH VALLEY TODAY WITHIN GENERALLY WEAK WSWLY FLOW REGIME. AT THE SURFACE...COLD FRONT FROM THE UPPER MS VALLEY THROUGH OZARKS INTO CNTRL TX WILL ADVANCE EWD/SEWD...REACHING THE UPPER OH VALLEY THROUGH LOWER MS VALLEY INTO LOWER RIO GRANDE VALLEY BY 08/12Z. THIS FRONT AND PRE-EXISTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WITHIN WARM SECTOR WILL SERVE AS FOCI FOR STRONG-SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY INTO SWRN TX/SERN NM
sections.text: 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS REVEAL THAT EML AND ASSOCIATED STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATE PLUME HAS BEEN CONFINED TO THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. WHEN COUPLED WITH A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND POTENTIAL FOR STRONG DAYTIME HEATING...EXPECT AFTERNOON WARM SECTOR TO ONCE AGAIN BECOME MODERATE-STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 2000-3500+ J/KG. INTERACTION OF AN ACTIVE COLD POOL ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING STORMS OVER NRN MS WITH A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT THE CONTINUED SWD/SEWD MOVEMENT OF MCS TODAY ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE LOWER MS VALLEY. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN RATHER WEAK...THOUGH THE STEEP LAPSE RATES AND POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE COLD POOL GROWTH WILL SUPPORT A FEW SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE ON THIS AREA...REFERENCE MCD 742. OVER THE ARKLATEX INTO CNTRL TX...LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT TSTMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE ALONG THE COLD FRONT THIS AFTERNOON. HERE TOO...VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN MARGINALLY SUPPORTIVE OF STORM ORGANIZATION. BUT...THE PRESENCE OF STRONG INSTABILITY WILL PROMOTE INTENSE UP/DOWNDRAFTS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. FARTHER W...BACKED LOW-LEVEL WIN

sections.title: OH/TN VALLEYS
sections.text: DESPITE THE PRESENCE OF A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE THAT WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND VERTICAL SHEAR ARE EXPECTED TO LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE TSTMS THROUGH THIS EVENING. THE EXCEPTION MAY BE OVER PORTIONS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY WHERE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR MAY BE ENHANCED BY THE LOCAL BACKING OF LOW-LEVEL WINDS AHEAD OF A MIGRATORY FRONTAL WAVE. HERE...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH A RISK FOR HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO. ..MEAD/LEITMAN.. 05/07/2012

sections.title: SW THROUGH SCNTRL TX AREA
sections.text: SEVERE STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG E-W ORIENTED FRONTAL BOUNDARY IN THE SAN ANGELO VICINITY. THE TENDENCY HAS BEEN FOR STORMS TO EVOLVE INTO A SMALL CLUSTER...AND LOCAL RADARS SHOW A CONSOLIDATED OUTFLOW SURGING SEWD. POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR ADDITIONAL STORMS TO DEVELOP ALONG THE PROGRESSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...AND OTHER STORMS MAY ALSO INITIATE FARTHER EAST ALONG THE FRONT WHERE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS CUMULUS INCREASING. VERTICAL SHEAR DECREASES WITH EWD EXTENT TOWARD THE HILL COUNTRY AREA. HOWEVER...THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT WITH 7.5-8.5 C/KM LAPSE RATES AND 3000-3500 J/KG MLCAPE WILL SUPPORT A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS INTO MID EVENING.

sections.title: OH VALLEY AREA
sections.text: HAVE EXPANDED THE SLIGHT RISK AREA A LITTLE FARTHER WEST TO ACCOUNT FOR STORMS DEVELOPING ALONG THE FRONT IN IND. STORMS FORMING ALONG AND AHEAD OF THIS BOUNDARY OVER THE OH VALLEY ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN A WEAK SHEAR ENVIRONMENT WITH MODERATE /1500-2000 J/KG/ MLCAPE SUPPORTIVE OF MULTICELLS. THE STRONGER STORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING GUSTS THROUGH EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: LINEAR MCS CONTINUES TO PROPAGATE SEWD ALONG ITS OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. STRONGEST STORMS MAY PERSIST ALONG WRN PORTIONS OF THIS BOUNDARY FROM SRN MS INTO NRN LA WHERE INFLOW OF HIGHER THETA-E AIR IS MAXIMIZED. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL. ..DIAL.. 05/07/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1117 AM CDT MON MAY 07 2012/

THE EXCEPTION MAY BE OVER PORTIONS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY WHERE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR MAY BE ENHANCED BY THE LOCAL BACKING OF LOW-LEVEL WINDS AHEAD OF A MIGRATORY FRONTAL WAVE. HERE...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH A RISK FOR HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO DEVELOP AND SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE REGION THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON. IT IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION THAT ACTIVITY COULD STRENGTHEN ENOUGH TO REQUIRE A SEVERE WEATHER WATCH...PARTICULARLY ACROSS WEST CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI...WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION APPEARS NEGLIGIBLE WITHIN A LIGHT FLOW...VERY WEAKLY SHEARED REGIME ACROSS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. BUT LIFT ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH AN OVERNIGHT MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IS MAINTAINING FAIRLY VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AS IT ADVANCES SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH NORTHWESTERN/NORTHERN MISSISSIPPI AROUND 25 KT. A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AHEAD OF THE LEADING EDGE OF THE OUTFLOW IS BECOMING MODERATELY UNSTABLE...WITH INSOLATION CONTRIBUTING TO MIXED LAYER CAPE OF 1000 TO 2000 J/KG...ALONG AN AXIS ACROSS CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI INTO WEST CENTRAL ALABAMA. THIS PROBABLY WILL SUPPORT CONTINUING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...ALONG WITH A GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION AND UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH THROUGH 18-19Z...WITH STRONGEST STORMS LIKELY TO IMPACT AREAS NEAR AND WEST OF JACKSON. MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL APPEARS THE GENERAL PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT...AT LEAST INITIALLY...BUT IT IS POSSIBLE THAT COLD POOL STRENGTHENING COULD EVENTUALLY BECOME SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT AN INCREASING RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..KERR.. 05/07/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS THE REGION DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID/UPPER FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION SPREADING NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHWEST TEXAS MAY BE CONTRIBUTING TO RECENT STORM DEVELOPMENT TO THE WEST OF SAN ANGELO. THIS APPEARS TO BE NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF A SLOWLY SOUTHWARD ADVANCING COLD FRONT...AND THE DRY LINE...WHERE THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER IS BECOMING STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH INSOLATION BENEATH VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. ONGOING CONVECTION MAY NOT YET BE SURFACE BASED...BUT A ZONE OF PERSISTENT LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE NEAR/ SOUTHWEST THROUGH SOUTH OF SAN ANGELO COULD BECOME THE FOCUS FOR ADDITIONAL INTENSIFYING STORM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH 20-22Z. ONCE THIS OCCURS...THOUGH LOW-LEVEL FLOW/SHEAR IS WEAK...DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING AT LEAST LARGE HAIL INITIALLY. ..KERR.. 05/07/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT BUT ISOLATED INSTANCES OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH STRONGER CELLS INTO THE EARLY EVENING. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE BEGINNING TO DEVELOP ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY PRODUCED BY OVERNIGHT CONVECTION ACROSS CNTRL OHIO. TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 70S TO LOW 80S EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AND WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 60S...THE AIR MASS HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND UNCAPPED. A BROAD CU FIELD WAS ALSO NOTED ON 17Z VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AND A FEW THUNDERSTORMS HAD ALSO DEVELOP ACROSS SWRN PA IN THE VICINITY OF A NWD RETREATING WARM FRONT. THIS AREA MAY ALSO SERVE AS ANOTHER FOCUS FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT INTO THE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING HOURS. DEEP LAYER FLOW ACROSS THE REGION REMAINS FAIRLY WEAK...AROUND 20-30 KT...AND THIS WILL LEAD TO MAINLY MULTICELL CLUSTERS AHEAD OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. SHOULD STORMS ORGANIZE ALONG THE BOUNDARY THEY WOULD POSE A GREAT RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. IN ADDITION TO THE WEAK SHEAR ENVIRONMENT...WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY SOMEWHAT INHIBIT STORM ORGANIZATION/UPDRAFT STRENGTH DESPITE THE UNSTABLE/MOIST ENVIRONMENT AND THEREFORE ONLY A MARGINAL SEVERE HAIL THREAT IS EXPECTED. STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND HIGH PW VALUES WILL AID IN GUSTY WIND POTENTIAL WITH ALL STORMS HOWEVER AND THIS IS EXPECTED TO BE THE MAIN THREAT INTO THE EARLY EVENING HOURS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POTENTIAL WW THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT IS INCREASING AND A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BY 21Z. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT ACROSS THE SERN NEW MEXICO PLAINS INTO SW TX INTO THE EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CUMULUS FIELD WAS INCREASING THIS AFTERNOON IN EASTERLY UPSLOPE FLOW ACROSS SERN NM AND A FEW TCU WERE NOTED ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE GUADALUPE AND SACRAMENTO MOUNTAINS. TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE MID 70S TO NEAR 80...RESULTING IN MODEST INSTABILITY AND DECREASING CIN. CAPPING SHOULD CONTINUE TO ERODE WITH CONTINUED HEATING THIS AFTERNOON AND AS A VORTICITY MAX APPROACHES FROM THE WEST /NOTED ON 19Z WV IMAGERY/...DEEP LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL INCREASE. BULK LAYER SHEAR OF 45-55 KT WILL FAVOR SUPERCELL STORM MODES AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES/COOL TEMPS ALOFT WILL AID IN LARGE HAIL PRODUCTION. STRONG WINDS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE GIVEN STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND LARGE TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BY 21Z FOR PORTIONS OF SE NM INTO SW TX.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH INTO FORWARD /EASTWARD/ PROPAGATING SEVERE MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM APPEARS LIKELY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS COULD SPREAD ACROSS THE TEXAS HILL COUNTRY INTO THE I-35 CORRIDOR OF SOUTH CENTRAL TEXAS BY 23-00Z. AN ADDITIONAL WW EAST OF 261 PROBABLY WILL BECOME NECESSARY WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INTENSE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT CONTINUES TO INCREASE IN THE PRESENCE OF STRONG CONVECTIVE INSTABILITY AND LARGE CAPE...FOCUSED NEAR/NORTH OF A PERSISTENT ZONE OF ENHANCED CONVERGENCE ACROSS THE EDWARDS PLATEAU. FLOW IN THE LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERE IS GENERALLY LIGHT...BUT...ALOFT...40-50+ KT WEST SOUTHWESTERLY WIND FIELDS APPEAR TO BE CONTRIBUTING TO AT LEAST 20 KT OR SO OF WESTERLY MEAN CONVECTIVE LAYER FLOW. DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...THIS SEEMS LIKELY TO CONTRIBUTE TO THE EVENTUAL EASTWARD ACCELERATION OF CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY...WHICH SHOULD CONTINUE TO GROW UPSCALE INTO AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM AS CONVECTIVELY GENERATED COLD POOLS CONSOLIDATE. AS THIS OCCURS...A BROADER SCALE DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY BECOME MORE PROMINENT... WITH ACTIVITY SPREADING ACROSS THE TEXAS HILL COUNTRY...AND PERHAPS APPROACHING THE WACO/TEMPLE/AUSTIN AND SAN ANTONIO AREAS BY 23-00Z. ..KERR.. 05/07/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT MAY OCCASIONALLY PRODUCE STRONG/GUSTY WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. EXPECTED DISORGANIZED/PULSE-TYPE NATURE OF CONVECTION WILL PRECLUDE THE ISSUANCE OF A WW AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE INCREASING ACROSS CENTRAL INTO SOUTHERN INDIANA THIS AFTERNOON IN A MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR MASS AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT FROM NEAR ASW TO DNV. WHILE THE AIR MASS HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE...WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND LACKLUSTER MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION AND SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS. HOWEVER...AN APPROACHING SHORTWAVE IMPULSE WILL LEND SOME UPPER LEVEL SUPPORT AND DEEPER LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT AND TEMPERATURES ALOFT ARE COOLING...SO SOME SMALL TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY BE POSSIBLE WITH STRONGER CELLS...BUT THIS SHOULD BE ISOLATED AND SHORT-LIVED. ADDITIONALLY...STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND HIGH PW VALUES COULD AID IN SPORADIC STRONG WINDS. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME GIVEN DISORGANIZED AND TRANSIENT NATURE OF CONVECTION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SPORADIC GUSTY WINDS MAY CONTINUE ACROSS SOUTHWESTERN PORTIONS OF WW 262 THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. OTHERWISE...SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING. A NEW WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED DOWNSTREAM AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE LARGELY WEAKENED ACROSS SRN MS AS A GUST FRONT HAS OUTRUN CONVECTION ACROSS MUCH OF THE WATCH. THE EXCEPTION BEING ACROSS PORTIONS OF NERN LA WHERE STORMS ARE STILL LIKELY SURFACE BASED AND AHEAD OF THE COLD POOL. THESE STORMS MAY STILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS AT TIMES GIVEN STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND HIGH PW VALUES. OTHERWISE...THE SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING ACROSS THE WATCH AREA AND A NEW WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED DOWNSTREAM. ..LEITMAN.. 05/07/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF STORMS IS DEVELOPING OVER W CNTRL AR...WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE INTO N CNTRL LA AND NERN TX. THESE STORMS MAY GRADUALLY DRIFT SEWD WITH TIME. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION IS BEGINNING TO INCREASE ALONG THE INTERSECTION OF A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY /EVIDENT ON 21Z VISIBLE IMAGERY FROM NERN LA NWWD INTO W CNTRL AR/ AND A COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM CNTRL TX NEWD TO ERN IND. A SUBTLE AREA OF IMPLIED FORCING FOR ASCENT IS NOTED ON WV IMAGERY OVER WRN AR/LA...AND APPEARS TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH YESTERDAY/S SEVERE CONVECTION IN CNTRL TX. AS SUCH...STORMS MAY BEGIN TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AMIDST A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. WINDS OF ABOUT 20-25 KT ABOVE 2 KFT PER VAD WIND PROFILE AND PROFILER DATA MAY SUPPORT WEAKLY ORGANIZED CLUSTERS OF STORMS...PRIMARILY CAPABLE OF DMGG WINDS AND HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PRIMARY SEVERE RISK SHOULD LIE WITH MCS INVOF HILL COUNTRY AND WITH TSTMS MOVING ACROSS THE RIO GRANDE TOWARDS PORTIONS OF THE EDWARDS PLATEAU. SEVERE THREAT N OF THE CONCHO VALLEY IN WW 261 APPEARS TO HAVE SUFFICIENTLY DIMINISHED TO CLEAR PRIOR TO 02Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOST INTENSE PORTION OF MCS WAS CENTERED OVER LLANO COUNTY AS OF 2215Z...WITH TRAILING OUTFLOW/EFFECTIVE COLD FRONT EXTENDING WWD TO ADDITIONAL CONVECTION DEVELOPING ACROSS THE RIO GRANDE INTO TERRELL/CROCKETT COUNTIES. PRIMARY RISKS SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND WITH A 52 KT GUST REPORTED AT JCT DURING THE PAST HOUR. DESPITE THE PRESENCE OF A WEAK CONFLUENCE AXIS TO THE EAST OF THE MOST INTENSE CORES...GRK VWP HAS SAMPLED MINIMAL SHEAR THROUGH 6 KM AGL WITH 0-3 KM SRH ONLY AROUND 10 M2/S2...WHICH SHOULD MITIGATE POTENTIAL FOR PERSISTENT TORNADIC SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. ACROSS MOST OF WW 261...THE STABILIZING EFFECTS OF THE MCS AND PRESENCE OF THE COMPOSITE OUTFLOW/FRONT BEING SHOVED TOWARDS THE RIO GRANDE SUGGESTS THAT AREAS N OF THE CONCHO VALLEY COULD BE CLEARED PRIOR TO WATCH EXPIRATION. ..GRAMS.. 05/07/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE HAIL AND WIND THREAT APPEARS TO HAVE PEAKED WITHIN WW 264 AND SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL AS CONVECTIVE MODE TRANSITIONS TO A BROADER CLUSTER EVOLVING EWD FROM SERN NM. A DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DISCRETE CELLS THAT HAD A HISTORY OF PRODUCING SEVERE HAIL HAVE LARGELY CONGLOMERATED INTO A CLUSTER OVER SERN NM. WITH MID/UPPER-LEVEL SWLYS AIDING IN EWD PROPAGATION OF THE CLUSTER INTO A PROGRESSIVELY COOLER AIR MASS IN THE S PLAINS OF NWRN TX...ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY BECOME INCREASINGLY ELEVATED WITH UPDRAFT INTENSITY WANING. STILL WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR AROUND 50 KT...RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL COULD PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS...BUT OVERALL THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR TO WARRANT A DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE. ..GRAMS.. 05/07/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS FAR SERN OK AND SWRN AR WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP SSEWD INTO NRN LA. A RELATIVELY BRIEF TEMPORAL THREAT OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY EXIST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MORE WELL-DEFINED CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS DEVELOPED ALONG THE MERGING COLD FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...PROGRESSING SSEWD TOWARDS GREATER INSTABILITY. WEAK LOW-MID LEVEL FLOW /GENERALLY ABOUT 20 KTS BELOW 500 MB PER 00Z LIT AND SHV OBSERVED SOUNDINGS/ SHOULD MAINTAIN A LOOSELY ORGANIZED NATURE OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION. STORMS MAY CONTINUE TO PRODUCE STRONG TO SEVERE WINDS/HAIL FOR A FEW HOURS BEFORE NOCTURNAL COOLING GRADUALLY BEGINS TO STABILIZE THE BOUNDARY LAYER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: REMNANT TSTM CLUSTERS INVOF TX HILL COUNTRY HAVE BECOME INCREASINGLY DISORGANIZED...WITH PULSE STORMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN NERN TX. RISKS FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS MAY PERSIST FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS BUT WILL LIKELY DIMINISH WITH TIME THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS OVER THE TX HILL COUNTRY HAS APPEARED INCREASINGLY DISORGANIZED IN THE PAST HOUR WITH OUTFLOW SURGING AHEAD OF STRONGER CORES APPROACHING THE AUSTIN/SAN ANTONIO AREA. WITH THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING...MODIFIED 00Z CRP RAOB WOULD SUGGEST THAT STRENGTHENING MLCIN MAY CURTAIL MCS REINTENSIFICATION WITHIN A WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. STILL...WITH RENEWED UPDRAFTS WITH SRN EXTENT ALONG THE RIO GRANDE WITHIN A HOT ENVIRONMENT /100 F AT 00Z AT LRD/...A SMALL WW MAY BE POSSIBLE FOR PARTS OF S TX. FARTHER NE...PULSE UPDRAFTS WITH MINIMAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /PER 00Z FWD RAOB/ ALONG THE COLD FRONT INTO NERN TX SHOULD POSE A NEAR-TERM RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALIZED MICROBURSTS. ..GRAMS.. 05/08/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DRIFT SWD/SEWD AND GRADUALLY WEAKEN WITH TIME. WW265 WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MUCH OF WW265 HAS BEEN RAIN COOLED/STABILIZED AND MAY BE REMOVED FROM THE WW. THE REMAINING FEW COUNTIES WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AS STORMS CONTINUE TO PROGRESS INTO/THROUGH NERN TX AND LA...OUT OF 265 AND INTO/THROUGH 266. THE FRONTAL/OUTFLOW MERGER CONTINUES TO INITIATE/SUSTAIN CONVECTION. 02Z SFCOA INDICATES CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IS STRENGTHENING...OWING TO NOCTURNAL COOLING. SURFACE TEMPERATURES ARE NOW GENERALLY IN THE 70S. AS SUCH...STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL LIKELY ONLY OCCUR FOR THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...WITH A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND THEREAFTER. ..HURLBUT.. 05/08/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW 264 IS SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z...BUT ELEVATED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO BECOME MORE NUMEROUS INTO THE OVERNIGHT WITH A RISK FOR AT LEAST MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. THE NEED FOR AN EXTENSION OR ADDITIONAL WW IS UNCERTAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOST INTENSE CORE WITHIN WW 264 WAS LOCATED IN GAINES COUNTY TX WITH A HISTORY OF SEVERE HAIL. FARTHER SW...A BROKEN LINE OF CELLS HAS INTENSIFIED OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF FAR W TX WITH FAVORABLE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT GIVEN POST-FRONTAL UPSLOPE FLOW WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF A SUBTROPICAL JET OVER NRN MEXICO. GIVEN 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR...RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL WILL LIKELY BE GREATEST DURING THIS INITIAL DEVELOPMENT. LATEST NAM/HRRR GUIDANCE SUGGEST CONVECTIVE COVERAGE WILL INCREASE OVERNIGHT. WITH TIME...CELL MERGERS/INTERACTIONS SHOULD LEAD TO DIFFICULTY IN MAINTAINING ELEVATED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AND CONSEQUENTLY MORE MARGINAL HAIL POTENTIAL GIVEN MODEST ELEVATED BUOYANCY WITH MUCAPE AROUND 1000 J/KG. ..GRAMS.. 05/08/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED OVER MUCH OF SWRN TX WITH MARGINAL HAIL LIKELY. A FEW WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED IF STORMS EVOLVE JUST RIGHT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BAND OF ELEVATED STORMS HAS FORMED FROM JUST S OF MIDLAND SEWD ACROSS THE HILL COUNTRY WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ALOFT...BUT THE CORES WERE FAIRLY WEAK. HOWEVER...WITH SUCH COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT...STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO FORM WITH INCREASING UPPER DIVERGENCE AND SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR FOR SOME SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AS WELL AS FORECAST SOUNDINGS FROM MULTIPLE MODELS INDICATE A RATHER POOR LAPSE RATE IN THE LOWEST SEVERAL KM...IN PART DUE TO COOL ELY SURFACE WINDS AND TEMPERATURES ONLY IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S F. THEREFORE...MARGINAL HAIL APPEARS TO BE THE MAIN THREAT FOR NOW WITH EFFECTIVELY SHORTENED HODOGRAPHS. HOWEVER...AS STORMS EXPAND ACROSS THE REGION...TRENDS WILL NEED TO BE MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF UPSCALE GROWTH SUGGESTING THE LOWER PORTIONS OF THE HODOGRAPHS ARE BEING MADE EFFECTIVE. MUCH GREATER PRECIPITABLE WATER EXISTS SE OF DEL RIO NEAR LAREDO. ..JEWELL.. 05/08/2012
